title: Custom imported authored sample
provenance: Illustrative authored 2D frame; no measured video, force or expert validation.

landmarks.label: Spine guide clearance
landmarks.why: Keep the physical clearance from the sheet's left/spine edge as its size changes.

landmarks.label: Center registration
landmarks.why: Retain the page's center as a fraction of its width and height.

landmarks.label: Top-edge indexing
landmarks.why: Keep physical distance from the top edge while retaining the along-edge fraction.

unknowns: Contact pressure and paper resistance were not measured.
Grain direction, adhesive choice and safe tool handling require expert review.
Marker geometry alone does not prove successful physical bookbinding.
